# Change Log

<!-- Generated by Copilot -->

All notable changes to the "highlight-open-files" extension will be documented in this file.

Check [Keep a Changelog](http://keepachangelog.com/) for recommendations on how to structure this file.

## [1.0.0]

- Forked from [highlight-files](https://github.com/ArturoDent/highlight-files) by Arturo Dent
- Renamed extension to **Highlight Open Files**
- Changed behavior to highlight all open files instead of only non-workspace files
- Renamed all settings from `highlightFiles.*` to `highlightOpenFiles.*`
- Renamed theme color from `highlightFiles.nonWorkspaceFiles` to `highlightOpenFiles.openFiles`
- Renamed class `FileDecorationProvider` to `OpenFileDecorationProvider`
- Changed setting scope from `resource` to `window`
- Bumped version to 1.0.0
